_comment: Sources the FQHC Breach & Advisory Watch checks every run. Edit freely; the routine reads this file fresh each time. 'kind' is a hint for how to read the page.

tracker_sheet.note: Guy's working copy of every item. The routine adds and updates rows; see PROMPT.md step 6a.
